actual_review.verbatim:
**Independent verdict: one distinct fixed-source candidate.** The mechanism is the first tropical fish’s finalization passing a leader and appearance tuple to later attempts in the same native group, with the alternate appearance branch ending that group early. The legacy ledger lists `TropicalFish.finalizeSpawn` as an unreviewed candidate. I found no accepted owner for the combined mechanism. [Author’s mechanism](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/general-tropical-fish-native-school-finalization-source-review-20261125.json:367) · [Legacy candidate](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/legacy-migration-acceptance/candidates.jsonl:15646)

- **Group data and loop scope.** `NaturalSpawner.java:139–148,168–187` resets `SpawnGroupData` for each outer pass and threads the `NATURAL` finalization return through the current inner loop. `AbstractSchoolingFish.java:45–58,102–119` records the first fish as leader and links later fish before admission. `TropicalFish.java:137–165,231–237` chooses a common tuple on the `<0.9D` branch and reuses it for later fish. The alternate branch draws a pattern and two colors independently, retains plain leader data, and sets `isSchool=false`. The resulting check breaks **only the current inner loop**, after the add request and accounting. The preceding Forge pack-size check can return from the whole call first. Eight is the base table’s group size and the default pack bound. Neither proves eight admissions. [Native loop](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/tools/cod4/legacy-migration-acceptance/.work/sources/minecraft-forge-1.20.1-47.4.10/net/minecraft/world/level/NaturalSpawner.java:139) · [Fish finalization](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/tools/cod4/legacy-migration-acceptance/.work/sources/minecraft-forge-1.20.1-47.4.10/net/minecraft/world/entity/animal/TropicalFish.java:137)
- **Custody and overlap.** The packed appearance survives entity saves and the separate `BUCKET` path (`TropicalFish.java:70–86,111–115,137–148`). The leader link and `isSchool` are transient. Later flock AI can recruit by class and follow state, allowing even a fish from the rare branch to join a live school (`FollowFlockLeaderGoal.java:23–41`). EA-0018 carries parent phenotype through reproduction. Frog conversion selects phenotype from the current biome, and EA-0065 consumes a retained adult phenotype in prey loot. Crow grouping is live behavior, and Crow’s accepted EA-0025 covers crop and cargo routing. The fish height waiver overlaps Drowned as placement support only: fish waive the `seaLevel−13` through `seaLevel` interval while retaining below-water and exact-water-above checks. Drowned waive a below-`seaLevel−5` cutoff on a different biome-and-odds branch (`TropicalFish.java:167–169`, `WaterAnimal.java:70–74`, `Drowned.java:95–111`). [Parent phenotype](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/batch-013.json:20) · [Crow](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/batch-019.json:21) · [Drowned comparison](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/general-tropical-fish-native-school-finalization-source-review-20261125.json:423)
- **Forge and birth proof.** The cached method contains finalization, add, pack-limit, and group-stop calls in that order. The packaged coremod targets `NaturalSpawner` and redirects the virtual finalization call. `ForgeEventFactory.java:278–288` forwards event-supplied group data or returns null when initialization is canceled. `setSpawnCancelled` separately affects admission. Rejected adds do not roll back the caller’s group counters or follower linkage. The current observer correlates finalize to join by UUID and later checks object presence with `!isRemoved()`. A stale UUID or a dying entity can pass those respective checks. Birth evidence needs the exact object, level and bounded `NATURAL` attempt tied to successful admission, then that same object alive on a later server tick. The cached binary and synthetic cases establish no observed birth. [Forge receipt](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/docs/cod4/audit-20261022/ecology-availability-research/general-tropical-fish-forge-redirect-and-birth-proof-20261126.json:353) · [Observer checks](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/tools/cod4/ecology-native-acceptance/src/com/dynasty/ecologyqa/NativeSceneDriver.java:131)

Offline and read-only. No formal intake or runtime credit. Baselines remain **83/1000**, **24/30** births, and **9/10** same-UUID pickups.

independently_confirmed_limits: Native attempt and actual world admission do not coincide. Follow linkage exists before add. A later fish school or matching packed appearance does not establish the original group call or exact NATURAL instance.

Biome height waiver is supporting overlap with the independent Drowned source. Serialized appearance and bucket restoration are not extra discovery units. Runtime regrouping has no appearance equality constraint, so a rare isolated branch can still later join a live school.
Forge cancellation of initialization and denial of spawn are separate, and effects on the matching runtime are unobserved. Current producer remains unchanged.
formal_intake: No ID or main-coordinator approval issued. Independent technical evidence itself cannot update counters.
